title: 0011 香火的来源0012 街亭镇
content_zh:
“大可不必担心，此间话外人是听不到的。胡守衡，字秉钧，曾任刑部主事，现在是东郊城隍。”
然而洪涛多虑了，城隍爷看似悲愤实则很谨慎，应该是用了某种法门把声音隔绝了。然后面色一正，虚拂袍袖，双手抱拳吉拜一礼。
“洪涛，无字，镇妖殿西殿诏狱行刑力士，见过胡大人！”
洪涛也赶紧有样学样，先自报家门，再环抱双臂躬身还礼。只不过俯身的幅度更大，双臂送得更远些。这叫土揖，是揖礼的一种，比胡城隍的时揖稍微隆重，用于向长辈和上官行礼。
“洪兄可知殷兄送来此诗刻于墓碑之上是何用意？”互相行礼就等于承认了身份，胡城隍再开口时已然换了称呼。
“呃……洪某曾向殷大人询问有没有其它渠道获得香火，他就将在下推到胡大人这里来了。”
“胡某将此诗镌刻于墓碑之上，有人前来吊唁时必会产生香火于洪兄识海。这就是获得香火的渠道，受世人崇拜敬仰，由感而起做不得假，也不能假托他人之名。”
胡城隍微微一笑，扇了扇手中的稿纸，淡淡解答了疑问。
“……还能这样！”这个回答百分百出乎洪涛的意料，甚至想都没想过。
“若是洪某再做些诗句，偶得机缘广为流传，是不是也能获得香火？”不过转念一想，好像也不奇怪。
香火来自于信仰，然而信仰并不局限于宗教，世间万物做到极致都可信。不过这样一来，自己岂不是等于有了金手指。脑瓜子里存的精彩诗句、科研成果不下万千，香火唾手可得啊！
“可也不可……朝廷对香火管控严格，若以诗成名必深受各方关注，即便侥幸得偿所愿也会受到神功司监管。除了将大部分香火上缴还要注重言词，不能越雷池半步。像这首诗大概不能流传。”
对于洪涛的大胆假设，胡城隍报以苦笑加轻蔑。因为个人收获香火的渠道并不是刚刚有，上百年了，朝廷就算再废物也不会视而不理，早就有了相应的对策。
“……原来如此……洪某恳请胡大人万万不可将此诗来源公之于众。”不用多想，洪涛就做出了决定，不能指望以诗成名。
不是说不想缴纳香火税，麻烦的是注重言辞、不能越雷池半步。说白了吧，不能写讽刺朝廷和社会弊端的诗句，必要的时候还得甘当肉喇叭替朝廷和皇帝吹嘘美化。
这个活儿说难不难，说易不易，全凭个人喜好。不巧的是自己天生反骨，最不擅长拍马屁恭维权贵，讽刺挖苦倒是信手拈来。
“此事尽管放心，实际上就算胡某想卖友求荣，洪兄也可矢口否认。在世人眼中洪兄不会作诗是必然，朝廷也无法分辨。殷大人想以此感谢洪兄作诗之义，自然会想到这些关节。”
胡城隍爷点了点头，并不做过多解释，也不等询问瞬间就消失在原地，连气流都不曾扰乱。
“嘿……洪某就此别过！”
洪涛还有很多事情想问，探头看了看后殿，里面空无一人。有心进去仔细找找，又怕守门的两位判官不高兴。好歹人家会法术，自己只是个不入流的狱卒，真得罪不起，还是走吧。

用一首诗改变了自己的身份，让城隍爷以士人之礼相待，真不是图虚名装逼，而是有很多话想问。结果却不尽如人意，尊重得到了，可诸多疑问还没彻底解开，反而更多了。
识海是啥，现在是一知半解。在脑门里面有个类似容器或者空间的玩意，凝神关注时可以感觉到它的存在，但又不是很清晰。
有什么用呢？对于普通人来讲屁用没有，只有经过香火神功融入启蒙后才有点用，拿来装香火。每个月发放的香火就是张盖了官印的符箓，当场往脑门上一贴，唰一家伙上面的香火就进入识海了。
到了识海里之后香火就属于个人所有了，可以拿来供奉官印也可以用在修行上。反正用一点少一点，只留下一丝痕迹。
当然也可以攒着不用，还不用担心丢失。至今为止还没听说谁能从别人的识海里把香火取走，自然也无法转增或者交易。
官方的香火体系比较复杂，殷云霄只简单提了提，应该也不是很清楚。大概意思是朝廷有个部门叫神功司，专门管理从各处收集上来的香火，再向各部门发放。
现在洪涛识海里唯一的异常就是太空了，干杂役十年没有香火可领，混到行刑力士之后每月5份，14年下来共800多份，空空荡荡的只有薄薄一层。
“大人，卑职遵照鲁王殿下之命将诗稿交与了此地城隍，现在可否回转？”
想不明白就不想，转到城隍庙前院见到典狱官还站在门口，赶紧过去回禀。顺口把此次的目的变成鲁王吩咐，来个拉大旗作虎皮，管不管用谁知道呢。
“既然如此本官就回去复命了，你且自去吧！”
在城隍庙遭到冷遇，还等了这么长时间，典狱官明显情绪不太好。听闻完成了使命，片刻都不想多待，转身大步走了出去。
“艹，有脾气你找城隍和鲁王发啊，和我甩脸子有个逑用！”这一天洪涛也累，身心俱疲，忍不住甩了句咧子。当然了，是等典狱官走远才小声嘀咕。
人微言轻，在等级森严的王权社会里小人物没有发牢骚的资格，想活着只能当缩头乌龟。同为行刑力士的周家兄弟都敢随意耍弄自己，也难怪被典狱官忽视。
要想被别人看得起就得自身足够硬。可是区区一个小狱卒又怎么能硬的起来呢？短时间内升官是别想了，长期钻营苟苟且且又非内心能忍。
辞去镇妖殿的职务去做买卖，靠奇技淫巧发财当个富家翁……同样也离不开钱权交易，背后没有靠山，先不说能不能发财，就算有了万贵家财瞬间也会化为乌有，还要招来杀身之祸。
其实还有条路可走，当个修士，炼出一身出神入化的功夫来个仗剑走天涯。天不管地不收，路见不平一声吼，事了拂衣去……
然而这条路同样也离不开权，没权就没香火，没香火就增进不了修为，没修为走个屁的天涯！想靠俸禄修行，再过60年才能到完成炼皮进入锻骨，仅仅就比寻常武夫更抗揍而已，何年何月是个头啊。
思来想去，洪涛愣是没找到一条适合自己的路。也不对，有条路，继续当反贼推翻这个朝代。看来自己生就了一身反骨，端端的乱臣贼子也！
“搞不好这辈子又是个反贼啊……我艹，马呢？”边瞎琢磨边走出城隍庙，左右看了看，一脑子造反计划顿时化为乌有，来时骑的马不见了。
“我呸！狗眼看人低……老人家、老人家，敢问可是要进城，能否载我一程？”那可是官马，还有镇妖殿的玄鸟烙印，偷它等于光天化日偷警车。不用问，肯定是被典狱官带走了。

其实没有马匹洪涛也能走回去，十几里路而已。可他不认路，来的时候也没记路，中途还有不少岔路和荒郊野外见不到人影，想靠问路走回去挺有难度。
好在刚好有辆牛车启程，赶车的是个老头，洪涛赶紧上前一揖，嘴上问能不能，可身子已经凑了过去，亮出掌心中的几枚铜钱。
“这位官人，小老儿是去街亭镇的，离麒麟门还有三里呢。此时的天色怕是赶不上进城了，不如先在镇上歇一宿，明日赶早。”赶车老头想挣顺手的钱，却不想骗人。
“……听人劝吃饱饭，敢问老人家上下高姓？”
洪涛还真没太留意时间问题，仔细一想也对。这个年月没路灯，天一黑基本就没人赶路了。反正明天也不当值，索性到镇子上看看，多了解下时代细节。
content_en:
"Don't worry, outsiders won't be able to hear what you say here. Hu Shouheng, courtesy name Bingjun, was once the head of the Criminal Department and is now the City God of the Eastern Suburbs."
However, Hong Tao was overly worried. The City God looked sad and angry but was actually very cautious. He must have used some kind of trick to block out the sound. Then his face straightened, he fluffed his robe sleeves, clasped his fists with both hands and bowed in auspiciousness.
"Hong Tao, Wu Zi, a warrior who was ordered to prison and executed in the west hall of the Demon Suppression Hall, has met Mr. Hu!"
Hong Tao also quickly followed suit, first announcing his home address, then folding his arms and bowing in return. It's just that he leaned forward wider and extended his arms further. This is called Tuyi, which is a kind of salute. It is slightly more grand than Hu Chenghuang's Shiyi, and is used to salute elders and superior officials.
"Brother Hong, do you know what Brother Yin's purpose was in sending this poem to be engraved on the tombstone?" Saluting each other was equivalent to acknowledging their identities. When Hu Chenghuang spoke again, he had already changed his title.
"Uh... Hong once asked Mr. Yin if there were other ways to obtain incense, so he pushed me to Mr. Hu."
"Hu Mou engraved this poem on the tombstone. When someone comes to express condolences, incense will be produced in Brother Hong's sea of consciousness. This is the channel to obtain incense. It is worshiped and respected by the world. It cannot be faked based on feelings, nor can it be faked in other people's names."
Hu Chenghuang smiled slightly, fanned the manuscript paper in his hand, and answered the question lightly.
"...How can it be like this!" This answer was 100% beyond Hong Tao's expectation, and he had never even thought about it.
"If Hong writes more poems and gets the chance to spread them widely, will he also get incense?" But after thinking about it, it doesn't seem strange.
Incense comes from faith, but faith is not limited to religion. Everything in the world can be trusted to the extreme. But in this way, wouldn't it mean that he has a golden finger? There are countless wonderful poems and scientific research results stored in my mind, and incense is at your fingertips!
"Yes or no...the imperial court has strict control over incense. If you become famous through poetry, you will be deeply concerned by all parties. Even if you are lucky enough to get what you want, you will be supervised by the Department of Divine Arts. In addition to turning in most of the incense, you must also pay attention to your words and not go too far. A poem like this probably cannot be spread."
Regarding Hong Tao's bold hypothesis, Hu Chenghuang responded with a bitter smile and contempt. Because the channels for individuals to harvest incense are not just new. For hundreds of years, the imperial court will not ignore it even if it is a waste, and has already had corresponding countermeasures.
"...I see...Hong kindly requests Mr. Hu not to disclose the source of this poem to the public." Without much thought, Hong Tao made a decision and could not expect to become famous with his poems.
It’s not that you don’t want to pay the incense tax. The trouble is that you pay attention to your words and don’t go too far. To put it bluntly, you can't write poems that satirize the ills of the court and society. When necessary, you have to be a trumpet to brag and beautify the court and the emperor.
Whether this job is difficult or easy depends entirely on personal preference. Unfortunately, he is naturally rebellious and is not very good at flattering the powerful, but he is very good at sarcasm and sarcasm.
"Don't worry about this matter. In fact, even if Hu wants to betray his friend for glory, Brother Hong can deny it. In the eyes of the world, it is inevitable that Brother Hong cannot compose poetry, and the court cannot tell it. Master Yin wants to thank Brother Hong for his poetry, so he will naturally think of these links."
Lord Hu Chenghuang nodded, without explaining too much, and disappeared immediately without waiting for questioning, without even disturbing the airflow.
"Hey...Hong, just say goodbye!"
Hong Tao still had many things to ask, so he looked into the back hall and found no one inside. I wanted to go in and search carefully, but I was afraid that the two judges guarding the door would be unhappy. After all, he is good at magic, and I am just a low-class jailer. I really can't afford to offend him, so I might as well leave.
He changed his identity with a poem and asked the City God to treat him with the courtesy of a scholar. This was really not an act of pretentiousness, but he had a lot to ask. The result was unsatisfactory, respect was gained, but many questions were not completely solved, but more questions were raised.
What is the sea of ​​consciousness? NowNow I only know a little bit about it. There is something like a container or space inside the forehead. When you pay close attention, you can feel its existence, but it is not very clear.
What's the use? For ordinary people, it is useless. It is only useful after the incense magical power is integrated into enlightenment, and is used to hold incense. The incense distributed every month is a talisman stamped with the official seal. Once it is pasted on the forehead, the incense on it will enter the sea of ​​consciousness.
After arriving in the sea of ​​consciousness, the incense belongs to the individual. It can be used to worship official seals or used in practice. Anyway, use a little less, leaving only a trace.
Of course, you can save it and don’t use it, so you don’t have to worry about losing it. So far, I have never heard of anyone being able to take incense away from other people's consciousness, and naturally it cannot be transferred or traded.
The official incense system is relatively complicated. Yin Yunxiao only mentioned it briefly, so he probably isn't very clear about it. It probably means that there is a department in the imperial court called the Shengong Division, which specializes in managing incense collected from various places and then distributes it to various departments.
Now the only anomaly in Hong Tao's sea of ​​consciousness is that it is in space. After working as a handyman for ten years, there is no incense. After becoming an executioner, there are 5 copies a month. After 14 years, there are more than 800 copies, and only a thin layer is empty.
"Sir, I humbly handed over the manuscript of the poem to the city god here in accordance with the order of His Highness King Lu. Can you turn back now?"
I didn't want to understand, so I turned to the front yard of the City God's Temple and saw the warden still standing at the door, so I hurried over to report back. He casually changed the purpose of this time to King Lu's order to raise the banner and make a tiger skin. Who knows whether it will work or not.
"In this case, I will go back to resume my duties. You can go on your own!"
After being treated coldly at the Chenghuang Temple and having to wait for such a long time, the warden was obviously not in a good mood. After hearing that the mission was completed, he didn't want to stay for a moment longer, turned around and strode out.
"Fuck, if you have a temper, you can take it out with the City God and King Lu. It's just for the sake of trying to get in trouble with me!" Hong Tao was also tired on this day, exhausted both physically and mentally, so he couldn't help but say something. Of course, he waited until the warden was far away before muttering in a low voice.
People speak softly, and in a hierarchical royal society, little people have no right to complain, and they can only live as little turtles. The Zhou brothers, who were both executioners, dared to play tricks on themselves, so it was no wonder they were ignored by the warden.
If you want to be respected by others, you have to be tough enough. But how can a mere little jailer be so hardened? Don't even think about getting promoted in a short period of time. You can't stand it if you stay in the job for a long time.
Resigning from the position in the Demon Suppressing Palace to do business, becoming a rich man by relying on uncanny skills and tricks... It is also inseparable from the transaction of money and power. There is no backer behind it. Let alone whether you can make a fortune, even if you have a huge wealth, it will disappear in an instant, and it will also lead to death.
In fact, there is still a way to go, to become a monk, to develop superb kung fu, and to travel to the ends of the world with a sword. The sky doesn't care and the earth doesn't take care of it. When you see an injustice on the road, you roar, and when it's over, you brush off your clothes...
However, this road is also inseparable from power. Without power, there will be no incense. Without incense, there will be no improvement in cultivation. Without cultivation, there will be no end of the world! If you want to rely on your salary to practice, it will take another 60 years to complete skin refining and bone forging. It is just more resistant to beatings than ordinary martial artists. How many years and months does it matter?
After thinking about it, Hong Tao couldn't find a path that suited him. That's not right. There is a way to continue to be a rebel and overthrow this dynasty. It seems that he has been born with a traitorous nature, a traitor and a treacherous traitor!
"Maybe I will be a rebel again in this life... Damn it, where is the horse?" I walked out of the City God's Temple while thinking about it. I looked around and saw that the rebellion plan I had in my mind suddenly disappeared. The horse I was riding on was gone.
"Bah! Dogs look down on people... Old man, old man, I want to go into the city, can you give me a ride?" That is an official horse, and it also has the black bird brand of the Demon Suppression Hall. Stealing it is equivalent to stealing a police car in broad daylight. No need to ask, he must have been taken away by the warden.
In fact, there is no horse Hong TaoWe can also walk back, only a dozen miles. But he didn't know the way, and he didn't remember the way when he came. There were many side roads along the way and there were no people in the wilderness, so it was difficult to walk back by asking for directions.
Fortunately, a bullock cart happened to be setting off, and the driver was an old man. Hong Tao quickly stepped forward and bowed, asking if he could, but he already leaned forward and showed a few copper coins in his palm.
"This official, this little old man is going to Jieting Town, which is still three miles away from Qilin Gate. I'm afraid it's too late to enter the city at this time, so why don't we rest in the town for a night and get up early tomorrow." The old driver wanted to make easy money, but he didn't want to lie to others.
"... After listening to people's advice to eat enough, do you dare to ask the old man his surname?"
Hong Tao really didn't pay much attention to the time issue. It would be right if he thought about it carefully. There are no street lights in this day and age, and almost no one is on the road once it gets dark. Anyway, I won’t be on duty tomorrow, so I’ll just go to the town to have a look and learn more about the details of the era.
